Printables are files, not slides: copy one into your unit folder, change its words, and render it. Its labels at the top (`title`, `type`, `order`, `audience`, `description`) put it in the unit's page and its packet. The pieces they use (blanks, lines, drawing boxes, word banks, vocab with 中文) are listed in each file's comments and in `_extensions/chalkline/shortcodes.lua`.

::: {.callout-note title="Packet pages"}
For the pages of a unit packet (A3, folded), see **Packet Templates**: about 30 page layouts in three print themes, with a teacher edition and loose sheets.
:::

## Worksheet: Angle Hunt

**Use it for:** the lesson's main task: find, draw and name, then one sentence with a frame · any "find it in the room" task · a lab record sheet.
**Pieces:** `{{</* blank */>}}` (a line to write on), `{{</* drawing-box */>}}`, `{{</* lines */>}}`, a frame. **File:** `course/guide/02-chalkline/angle-hunt.qmd` (copy it from Chalkline's `guide/angle-hunt.qmd`).

{{< pdf-viewer "angle-hunt.pdf" layout="gallery" title="Angle Hunt" >}}

## Handout: Thinker Card

**Use it for:** a card students fill in about a person, a place or a thing · a museum card · a character profile.
**Pieces:** headed sections, blanks, a drawing box, a frame to say to a partner. **File:** `guide/example-handout.qmd`.

{{< pdf-viewer "example-handout.pdf" layout="gallery" title="Thinker Card" >}}

## Checklist: Self-Check

**Use it for:** the packet page students do before they leave: rate each "I can" with stars, show it, write one sentence · a self-assessment before a test · peer feedback.
**Pieces:** a table of "I can" lines with stars, a drawing box, a frame; teacher look-fors in a teacher-only block. **File:** `guide/self-check.qmd`.

{{< pdf-viewer "self-check.pdf" layout="gallery" title="Self-Check" >}}
